items.summary: The PLA Air Force said on the 14th that test pilots of multiple fighter types will appear at the 16th China International Aviation & Aerospace Exhibition, showcasing the modern Air Force test-pilot corps.
items.summary_zh: 【空军多型战机试飞员将亮相第十六届中国航展】财联社11月14日电，人民空军14日组织试飞员代表走进清华大学宣讲，记者在现场获悉，空军多型战机试飞员将亮相第十六届中国航展，全方位展现新时代空军试飞队伍的风采

items.title: Cailianpress, Nov 14: Iran's IRGC said on the 14th that within hours at least four oil tankers struck mines and caught fire in the Strait of Hormuz
items.title_zh: 财联社11月14日电，伊朗伊斯兰革命卫队14日通报称，几小时内，至少有4艘油轮在霍尔木兹海峡触雷起火。

items.title: Without Huang Jen-Hsun, would Nvidia become a 'bureaucratic machine'?
items.title_zh: 没有黄仁勋，英伟达会是个“官僚机器”？
items.summary: SemiAnalysis founder Dylan Patel revealed the company repeatedly emailed Huang directly to resolve issues; without his direct involvement, future Rubin manufacturing problems would be slower to fix.
items.summary_zh: SemiAnalysis创始人Dylan Patel透露，公司曾多次直接给黄仁勋发邮件解决问题，若未来Rubin出现制造问题，缺少黄仁勋直接参与将导致问题处理更慢

items.title: Huang Jen-Hsun is gone — will Nvidia still be Nvidia?
items.title_zh: 黄仁勋走了 英伟达还会是那个英伟达吗
items.summary: After days of drama, Huang's resignation has brought a temporary close.
items.summary_zh: 多日闹剧，伴随着黄仁勋的辞任短暂落下帷幕

items.title: Nvidia posts worst weekly performance in 18 months as Huang's departure prompts market revaluation
items.title_zh: 英伟达创18个月最差单周表现，黄仁勋离职引发市场重估
items.summary: Nvidia's shares suffered their worst weekly decline in over 18 months this week, wiping out more than $620 billion in market value.
items.summary_zh: 英伟达股价本周遭遇逾18个月以来最惨烈的单周跌幅，市值蒸发超过6200亿美元

items.title: AI risks are the biggest threat to the financial system, Fed survey finds
items.title_zh: 美联储调查：AI 风险是金融体系面临的最大威胁
items.summary: The report comes with Wall Street on edge over high-flying AI hyperscalers, while communities are on alert for the rapid spread of data centers.
items.summary_zh: 该报告发布之际，华尔街对高飞的 AI 超大规模厂商感到不安，各地社区也在警惕数据中心的快速扩张。
